definitions.explanation: A large warship designed for long-range operations, faster than a battleship but with less armor. Historically one of the main classes of naval warships, now largely replaced by modern guided-missile ships that retain the cruiser designation.

examples.japanese: {巡洋艦|じゅんようかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{停泊|ていはく}→停泊：20272_teihaku⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A cruiser was anchored in the harbor.

examples.japanese: {第二次世界大戦|だいにじせかいたいせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{巡洋艦|じゅんようかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}した→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: Many cruisers saw action during World War II.

examples.japanese: ⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧{巡洋艦|じゅんようかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{模型|もけい}→模型：07079_mokei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{当時|とうじ}→当時：01615_touji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{海軍力|かいぐんりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{物語|ものがた}っている→物語る：18730_monogataru⟧。
examples.english: The cruiser model on display in the museum tells the story of the naval power of that era.

notes:
Composed of {巡洋|じゅんよう} (cruising, patrolling the seas) and {艦|かん} (warship). The term originally described warships designed for long ocean patrols. Japanese cruisers are subdivided into {重巡洋艦|じゅうじゅんようかん} (heavy cruisers) and {軽巡洋艦|けいじゅんようかん} (light cruisers) based on armament and displacement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重|じゅう}{巡洋艦|じゅんようかん}: heavy cruiser
- {軽|けい}{巡洋艦|じゅんようかん}: light cruiser
- ⟦ミサイル→ミサイル：26959_misairu⟧{巡洋艦|じゅんようかん}: guided-missile cruiser

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{戦艦|せんかん}→戦艦：18783_senkan⟧: battleship — larger and more heavily armored than a cruiser
- ⟦{駆逐艦|くちくかん}→駆逐艦：23389_kuchikukan⟧: destroyer — smaller and faster than a cruiser
- ⟦{空母|くうぼ}→空母：15702_kuubo⟧: aircraft carrier — a warship that carries and launches aircraft
